steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, your delivery has arrived, hopefully in good time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yeah... It has arrived, but do I really need to wear this? I feel like it doesn't suit me...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Sorry Chief, but the request is for both you and the Sinners to "fit in perfectly" at the party, so please hang in there.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Nobody told me it's this kind of "party," though?
After hearing you promise that you'll complete the mission, Nightingale hung up the phone. You look at your outfit inside the locker room, still feeling a bit uncomfortable.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's a bit too revealing...
As soon as you open the door, you're bombarded by a summery cacophony of colorful swimsuits and pool toys, splashing pool water, and the sweet scent of watermelon and mango.

steps.speaker: Guest A
steps.content: Hey, what's up bro? why are you wearing so much at a pool party?
steps.female_content: Hey there, missy, why are you wearing so much at a pool party?

steps.speaker: Guest A
steps.content: You should take off that shirt! You won't be able to party if you get heat stroke!

options: No thanks, I'm fine as I am.

steps.speaker: Guest A
steps.content: Sigh, how lame.
You pull the sides of your buttonless shirt closer together, weave around the person and keep heading forward.
Soon after, you hear a familiar voice among a group of stunning swimsuit-clad bombshells.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Th-thank you, but there's really no need...

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, where are you...!

steps.speaker: Swimsuit Bombshell A
steps.content: Emm? ${PlayerName}? Who's that? Someone important?

steps.speaker: Swimsuit Bombshell B
steps.content: Or is it just the "person who brought you here"?

steps.speaker: Swimsuit Bombshell C
steps.content: Oh, who cares? Take another bite, sweetie... Can you guess how many flavors there are in this cup of ice cream?
A swamped Kelvin spots you through the crowd and quickly squeezes her way out.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Sorry, m-my friend is here! I have to go with him to... uh...
steps.female_content: Sorry, m-my friend is here! I have to go with her to... uh...

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: To find another friend! Thanks for everything. See you later!
Kelvin fixes her disheveled ponytail and bows to the swimsuit bombshells. She then turns around and hurries to your side.

steps.speaker: Swimsuit Bombshell A
steps.content: Hey, if you're free later, bring your friend to hang out with us together!
You smile awkwardly and promise them that you will, before quickly pulling Kelvin away from the scene.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All right. Now we just need to find Macchiato to combine our information.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Where did you two split off?

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Next to the little stage... Miss Macchiato said she saw an acquaintance of hers who might have clues and left...

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: It's all my fault... I shouldn't have been so curious about that strange ice cream!

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: That way, I wouldn't have been bogged down by those girls. I failed to find any useful clues... and even lost Miss Macchiato in the end.
You comfort Kelvin as you look towards the stage by the swimming pool.
Partygoers spontaneously jump onto the stage one after another, twerking wildly or bellowing out indecipherable lyrics at the top of their lungs.
Yet the crowds in the pool scream and cheer no matter what the performance is.

steps.speaker: Singing Man
steps.content: I dedicate this song to the light of my life!!

steps.speaker: Singing Man
steps.content: Oh...! I don't know where you are right now, but... I hope I can see you in the very next second!

steps.speaker: Singing Man
steps.content: Miss Macchiato! Please keep cracking your whip!
The ecstatic partygoers throw up their hands and cheer on the guy who bravely professed his love on stage.
Like a pop star, the singing man turns his back to the audience and leaps into the pool with a scream.
The audience hollers and laughs, reaching out to caress the guy who just jumped in, as if touching him would bring the same fervent "emotions" to themselves.
Behind the partition of the little stage, you can see the "light of the singer's life" squatting there with her head buried between her knees, covering her ears and muttering to herself.

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: Ahhhh... Why did this have to happen... It's so embarrassing...

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: Why did he have to say that out loud!

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: I know he likes to be spanked, but... ahhh no no no, the Chief and Miss Kelvin must have heard it, what should I do...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's fine... Life is short...

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Just sleep on it, Miss Macchiato.
Macchiato raises her head, spotting you and Kelvin. She blushes and shuts her eyes again with a soft cry.
You and Kelvin sit down next to Macchiato. You hear waves of screams from the other side of the partition, mixed with the sound of splashes and obscene words.
You can't help but sigh.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Good thing we didn't bring Hella and Hecate... We can't let them see things like that...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now it's time for us to mingle with the crowd. After all, you're an expert on gourmet cuisine, while you're a fixture in Eastside high society...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let's try our best together!
Three days ago...
In the council hall, a few Eastside sheriffs stand before you, presenting a request letter without saying a word.
You take the request letter. You notice a lavish invitation peppered with gold sparkles attached to its back.

Dear invitee, 

You are cordially invited to our magnificent banquet at Ogygia Villa on ?? ??, N.F. ??.
It will be a feast to please all tastes, and we look forward to your arrival.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So this means... the host of this party stole Miss Franc's "treasures"?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And you want me to go there to help her find them...?
You ask them this after you finish reading the letter, clutching the invitation in your hands.

steps.speaker: Eastside Sheriff
steps.content: That's right. The Francs are a prominent family in Eastside, and Miss Cabernet Franc is a renowned food critic who greatly influences the city's culinary trends.

steps.speaker: Eastside Sheriff
steps.content: A lot of famous guests will be attending this party. Deploying special security forces may draw unnecessary attention from onlookers and cause mass panic.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But...
Just as you're about to retort, the officials hand you another piece of information.

steps.speaker: Eastside Sheriff
steps.content: You must be familiar with this, right?
The corrugated seal on the file catches your attention.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The Thaumas Society?!

steps.speaker: FAC Official
steps.content: That's right. This party is being held at Ogygia Villa, one of the gathering places of the "Thaumas Society." The MBCC has been trying to track them down for a long time. It's the online group that we've always suspected had Sinners in it.

steps.speaker: FAC Official
steps.content: These past few days, we've detected abnormal M-value fluctuations over there. We suspect that it may be caused by the Sinners involved with the Thaumas Society.

steps.speaker: FAC Official
steps.content: So... When we were deciding who to dispatch, we thought it'd be best for the MBCC Chief to go personally.
You fall silent, tuck away the invitation, and bow to the sheriffs and officers.

steps.speaker: FAC Official
steps.content: I'll send the details to your comms device later. Thanks for taking on yet another mission... MBCC Chief.
